reason: The cited code executes `args.script` via `page.evaluate`, which is browser-page JavaScript rather than arbitrary host code execution, so HOSTEXEC is not established. The result and console logs are returned to the agent, and because the evaluated script/page can produce attacker-controlled output, UNTRUSTED is supported. Browser-page JavaScript can initiate requests to attacker-readable URLs chosen in the supplied script, so these lines support SINK. SECRET is not settled by these lines alone: they do not show that the page contains or can reach non-public user data, host files, localhost, databases, or credentialed SaaS content.
